details.description:
OM Bhakti Diyas are beautifully painted to decorate your home, bright and colorful.
Lighting a Lamp has a deep spiritual significance. The light of the lamp is considered to destroy ignorance, bestow knowledge and bring in auspiciousness.
OM Bhakti Cotton Battis are also provided to be used for lighting the Diyas.

Om Bhakti Pancha Deep Oil is a sacred blend of five pure oils, carefully combined in perfect proportion to uphold the purity and sanctity of your prayers. Specially formulated for lighting diyas and lamps, this divine oil enhances the spiritual ambience of your space. While non-edible, it serves as a safe and soothing aromatizer, filling your surroundings with a serene and uplifting essence, making every prayer and ritual more meaningful.
Panchadeepa oil is a type of oil that is commonly used in religious rituals. It is usually made from a blend of different oils and is often infused with fragrant herbs. The oil is used to anoint the idols of deities during puja, or prayer, ceremonies, and is also used to light the diyas or lamps that are an essential part of rituals. Puja oil is believed to have purifying and cleansing properties, and using it is considered to be a way of offering respect and devotion to the divine. The light symbolises the absence of darkness, grief and sorrows. The Pancha Deepa Oil is strongly suggested to light a lamp to nullify all evil and bring knowledge, health and wealth into your home.
The Pancha Deepa Oil is a blend of 5 Natural Oils in perfect and pure proportion to ensure that the purity and sanctity of your prayers are protected. Each of these 5 oils has their significance and should be mixed in the perfect ratio in the purest sense. Lighting lamps with Pancha Deepa Oil brings happiness, health, wealth, fame and prosperity to your home.
OM Bhakti Pancha Deepa Oil is used for daily Puja purpose for lighting diyas/lamps. The Pancha Deepa Oil is a blend of 5 oils gingelly oil, castor oil, lluppai(mahua) oil, coconut oil, rice bran oil & fragrance. This blend of oils also aids in lighting the Diya for longer time. When lighted with Pancha Deepa Oil, the puja room also gets the fragrance as the Diya starts lighting with the Pancha Deepa oil.
details.usageInstructions:
Take one pair of Om Bhakti Cotton Batti and place it in the Brass diya/ lamp.
Take Pancha Deepa Oil and pour it into the lamp. Ensure that the tip is also wet with the oil.
Now light the lamp at the tip.
